_doc: Per-building facade looks for the campus, merged into data/cycu.json as building.look by tools/build_map.py (keyed by OSM id; src/world/MapBuilder.js draws them).

Values are read off the Google 街景 / 衛星 survey text of each building (handoff buildings_merged.json): the source field says where it was seen, confidence how sure it is (high / medium / low). No imagery is stored.
Heights, floors and footprints are not set here (tools/overrides.json). A look building draws its walls from the facadeParam atlas (src/graphics/Textures.js), one window-type row per storey.
look.wall: base = tile | smooth | stone (texture of the wall finish), colour = wall hex, stripes = [hex..] wall colour per storey from the 2nd up (cycled).

look.windows: type = punched | pair | ribbon | curtain | grid | slit | louver | arch | gallery | none; ground = type of the ground floor; types = per storey from the ground (last repeats); bay = window spacing m; accent = frames / mullions / pilasters / louvers / arch recess hex; glass = glass tint hex.
look.faces: [{on, colour, accent, glass, windows}] overrides for walls facing on = n|ne|e|se|s|sw|w|nw (or a list), or 'long' / 'short' (sides of the footprint's oriented box).

look.bands: [{colour | colours (cycled per storey; grade true = spread bottom to top over all bands), at = fraction of a storey above the slab (or a list), from / to = storeys (default 1 .. floors-1), every, h = thickness m, depth = projection m, on}] floor bands, sills, sunshades.
look.fins: [{spacing, depth, t, colour, from, to, on, ends}] vertical fins / pilasters; from (storey, default 1) keeps them above head height.

look.plinth: {floors | h, colour}; look.topFloor: {floors, colour, windows, glass, setback (m; > 0 steps back with a terrace, < 0 the lower floors are recessed under it)}; look.corner: {w, colour, from, on, minLen} corner piers (on: only at both ends of the wall >= minLen m facing each direction; default every corner); look.parapet: {h, colour}.

look.canopy: [{on, at (fraction along the wall), w, d, h, rise (> 0 gabled tile roof), colour, roofColour, postColour, posts, t}]; look.portal: {on, at, near ([x, z]: the wall facing on closest to it), w, d, floors, arches, type (window row, default arch), colour, accent, rise} a frontispiece in front of the wall.

look.roof: {colour, shape (pitched roof drawn for looks only, e.g. gabled / hipped), rise, solar ({u, v, colour} fractions of the oriented box, or true), boxes ([{at [u, v] fractions or corner (n / ne / ... : 1 m inside that corner), size [w, d] m, h, colour, topColour}]: stair cores, roof lights), ac (false = no AC units), extras (false = no 透天 stair house / 鐵皮 shed / tank)}.
look.open: {floor, kerb, rail} an open-air pad (no walls or roof) with a kerb and a 1 m railing; the footprint and its random draws stay as they are.
skip: the entry is survey data only and is not merged (the footprint is drawn elsewhere).

noShop: copied to the building (kind town buildings that are not shops: no shopfront or awning). There is no shed field here: shed 0 would skip the shed's rb() draws, so roof.extras false hides the 鐵皮 shed instead. Nothing here may change the shared random streams in src/world/MapBuilder.js (see the comments there).
